home.heroTitle: ADVANCED INTEGRATIVE PROCESSING OF PLANT BIORESOURCES TO OBTAIN NATURAL INNOVATIVE PRODUCTS AT EU QUALITY STANDARDS
home.heroSub: Main objective: to obtain new innovative traditional assortments from plant bioresources by adding bioactive compounds and natural flavorings, developing professional skills and increasing socio-economic benefits for small farmers.
scopulCards: Maximize profits for agri-food producers compared to selling unprocessed goods.
Raise professional level through advanced processing technologies and entrepreneurial/creative capacity.
Broaden socio-economic knowledge for the sustainable development of households.
Expand categories of bioresources that can be profitably processed through innovation.
Encourage acquisition of new equipment for processing local bioresources.
Enable technology transfer of project results to specialists.
home.rezultateTeaser: Research delivered health-oriented products based on fruits and honey, enriched with bioactive compounds.

items.title: Raspberry jelly enriched with resveratrol
benefits: Rich in vitamins and minerals (C, K, E, B, magnesium, copper, iron, potassium).
Favors slower digestion, reducing sugar spikes.
items.body: Raspberries are flavorful and nutritious, low in calories yet rich in micronutrients. Their low sugar and GI profile makes them suitable for blood sugar management.

items.title: Blackcurrant jelly enriched with resveratrol
items.excerpt: Fruit-based gel jelly rich in bioactive compounds.
items.body: Gelled product made from fruit juices/pulps with sugar, acids and pectin. Blackcurrants have a rich nutritional profile and valuable bioactives.

items.title: Blueberry jelly enriched with resveratrol
benefits: High nutrient density with few calories.
Vitamin K works synergistically with vitamin D.
items.body: Blueberries are considered super-fruits: nutrient-dense with low calories. Vitamin K plays an essential role for bones and the cardiovascular system.

items.title: Creamed honey with blackcurrant pulp and yulisca extract
items.body: Obtained by homogenizing natural extracts and aromatic spices with honey/fructose, designed for well-being and cognitive support.

project.title: Project
project.obiectivPrincipalBody: To obtain new innovative traditional assortments from plant bioresources by adding bioactive compounds and natural flavorings, developing capabilities and increasing socio-economic benefits for small farmers.
obiectiveSecList: Inventory local plant bioresources and process data in a logistics software built on lab analyses.
Obtain value-added dairy products/preparations by adding concentrated extracts of bioactive compounds and natural flavorings.
Superior valorization of by-products through conditioning: bases for functional feed and natural fertilizers.

programFinantare.submasura: Sub-measure 19.2 – Support for implementing actions within the Local Development Strategy
